notes.title: Update 3 - Tradução PT-BR
notes.content:
Calmed by the Dark Games é um estúdio BR de jogos indie, mas até agora nunca tinha lançado algum jogo no nosso idioma.

Tradução para português de Calmed by the Dark Shin Neon chegou para mudar isso!

notes.title: Update 2 - New weapons added.
notes.content:
[h1]New Weapons Added![/h1]
In this second update for Calmed by the Dark Shin Neon, new weapons have been added.

Tommy can now buy and equip new ranged and special weapons, such as a Shotgun, Rifle, Dagger, Whip and more...
Weapons are equipped directly in the Mission Screen.

notes.title: Update 1 - Control Compatibility
notes.content:
In this first update of Calmed by the Dark Shin Neon, [b]full compatibility with control[/b] was added.

PS/Xbox Controller:
[list]
[*] D-Pad/Left Analog - Move Character
[*] X/A - Interact/Confirm
[*] O/B - Cancel
[*] R1/RB: Melee Attack
[*]  R2/RT: Range Attack
[*] L2/LT: Special Attack
[*] L1/LB: Parry/Guard
[*] SQUARE/X: Dodge
[*]  TRIANGLE/Y: Menu
[/list]
